data.description: Phrase each conflict as a neutral question to confirm, never an accusation
data.body:
Write every conflict as a neutral question the adviser can put to the client, for example
"Which start date is correct?".

**Why:** most conflicts are typos or date-format differences, and advisers forward the
questions to clients.
**How to apply:** give both versions with their sources, then ask which one is right; never
say a document is wrong.
Related: [[intake-form-v1-dates]]
evidence: never as an allegation that a document is wrong
